description: A company's filed record: annual income, balance-sheet and cash-flow lines from SEC XBRL, revenue mix by reported segment, the latest filings with plain-language summaries and links, Form 4 insider trades (planned vs unplanned; here 'unplanned' means not under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, so it also counts tax-withholding sales and option exercises), 13F holder counts by quarter, risk-factor changes and earnings-call dates. Signed in, it adds the research the user's plan includes: the verdict and its reasons, what would change it, valuation, prices and analyst estimates. Where the company's primary trend is matched, trend_revenue_share_pct is the share of its revenue tied to that trend, and trend_revenue_share_basis says whether it is measured from reported segments or estimated.
name: get_company
title: Get a company's filed record
